text:
nina: planning a Wed midnight window in apac-zone2 (00:30-02:30 local). Objective: siphon ~10% of nodes from the dedicated GPU pool, pre-drain workloads, run NIC microfirmware flip, then rolling reboot. Primary goal is to preseed KV/prefix caches on warm hosts so we avoid cold-start token spikes. Expect a transient capacity hit ~9%.

sanjay: clarify — will we use spot backfill or reserve burst capacity during the window? cost/backfill tradeoff?

nina: good q. we'll prefer reserved burst where possible (dedicated pool) for predictability; small spot refill allowed for nonpriority jobs. cost estimate: ~0.6 GPU-hours per hour of window for spot churn (~$2.1/hr across region).

kai: I'll own the preseed. plan is to run the `kv-prime` job to copy hot KV to targets before taking them live. snippet: ```bash
# run from ops bastion
kv-prime --targets=apac-zone2:poolB --prefixes=/cache/prefixes/prime-2026-03-24.json 
--parallel=8 --timeout=900
```

kai: will also push a tiny health check container that warms model weights on startup (small 50MB reads).

eva: telemetry owners: watch p99 latency for generation endpoints and token throughput. Alert if p99 generation > 450ms for >3m or error-rate >0.5% for 5m. Also track KV cache hit-rate — we want >85% within first 10m of bringing node back.

ops-bot: maintenance-scheduler created maintenance 6249876543 00:30-02:30 APAC-Z2. Reminder set 2h before window.

mike: support/comms: do we need customer-facing notice? any tenants on dedicated pools impacted?

nina: minimal customer-facing impact expected. we'll only notify high-priority tenants pinned to poolB; list curated by support. fallback policy: traffic will route to compatible model variants and smaller-sized instances if needed.

sanjay: one more thing — can we stagger the siphon so we never drop >5% capacity per 10m? want to avoid hot queueing.

kai: yes — plan: cohorts of 3 nodes every 12m, kv-prime runs ahead of cohort bring-up.

eva: add a short lived synthetic load generator after each cohort bring-up to validate tail latency before next cohort. I can script that.

mike: i'll draft a brief support blurb and tag affected accounts. will need the tenant list by EOD Wed.

nina: owners: sanjay (capacity sequencing + cost), kai (preseed + scripts), eva (telemetry + synthetic checks), mike (support comms). I'll lead ops during the window.

nina: runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/node-siphon-kv-priming (follow checklist, abort conditions listed).

ops-bot: CI job `kv-prime` scheduled by kai at 6249878500 (post-window verification).

eva: noted. i'll add dashboards + a lightweight alert dashboard link in the runbook.

kai: prepping the preseed artifact now, will post the job command in this thread when ready. :hammer_and_wrench:

mike: thanks — please ping #support 30m prior. :thumbsup:

nina: will do. syncing 2h before for a final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
